_description: Default weights of the global layout score (one shared source read by the site and the app through _shared/ui/layout_analysis/_generated/analysis_data.js). Each weight is the number of score points one unit of the metric is worth (one percentage point, or one millimetre for distance); the sign comes from the metric's direction, so every weight is positive. The choice of each value is justified in docs/audits/layout-analysers/report.md, section « Default weights ».
